mech: "Although" signals contrast — the blank must oppose exact measurements. The second half then defines it.

stem: The hallway was so ______ that we could hear the clock ticking three rooms away.
mech: The second half proves the answer: hearing something faint requires silence.

stem: Because the bridge was ______, the city closed it until repairs could be made.
mech: "Because" links cause to effect. Only one option explains a closure.

stem: The puppy was ______, knocking over two lamps before anyone could catch it.
mech: The example after the comma defines the blank — knocking things over isn't calm behavior.

stem: She spoke with such ______ that nobody doubted she had rehearsed her speech many times.
mech: Rehearsal produces assurance; two options describe its opposite.

stem: The instructions were ______, so even the youngest camper set up her tent without help.
mech: The result — a young child succeeding alone — tells you what the instructions must have been.

stem: Despite the ______ weather, the team finished the entire game.
mech: "Despite" signals contrast — the weather must work against finishing.

mech: Six hours of watching one spot requires sustained attention, not the opposite.

stem: Marcus was ______ about the surprise party, refusing to give his sister even one hint.
mech: The second half defines it: withholding hints is deliberate secrecy, not forgetfulness.

mech: Tasting like water means something is missing — and it isn't more water.

mech: Collapsing defines the state. Two options describe the opposite of tired.

mech: Five trials strengthen a conclusion — the semicolon's second half is evidence for the blank.

mech: "Though" signals contrast — the blank must oppose arguing at length. Two options describe someone who already speaks up.

mech: If fighting resumed, the treaty accomplished nothing real. Three options claim it worked.

mech: The result — immediate understanding by the unprepared — requires clarity specifically, not brevity or detail.

mech: "Without consulting anyone affected" defines the blank. Three options describe the opposite process.

mech: The measurement after the comma defines the word precisely.

mech: The contrast between two pages and three hundred is the clue — the pacing collapsed.

stem: He was ______ in his praise, mentioning every member of the team by name.
mech: Naming everyone is the definition of unstinting praise.

mech: "Leaving each team free" defines the blank — and "deliberately" tells you it was a choice.

stem: Once a ______ port, the town now sees perhaps one cargo ship a year.
mech: "Once" plus "now" signals a reversal — the blank must contrast with near-emptiness.

mech: Changing details is the definition given after the comma.

stem: Far from being ______, the policy actually widened the very gap it was designed to close.
mech: "Far from" reverses the blank — the policy did the opposite of what the blank claims.
